primary_prior_source: Kreuzer and Veeser, arXiv:1903.05915v1; Numerische Mathematik 148 (2021), 43-78, DOI 10.1007/s00211-021-01194-8

findings.endpoint: Lemma 21 minimizes over all NVB meshes and all P0 coefficients; Lemma 4(ii) immediately implies the global H^-1 endpoint failure.
findings.bridge: The candidate bubble equals (2|e|/3) times KV formula (3.19b) in 2D; it uses the same element-mean annihilation.
findings.logarithmic_lower_rate: A logarithmic lower bound is not literally printed in KV Lemma 21; the explicit CDN2011 final sentence only gives n*4^(-n-2). Direct Cauchy on CDN allocation, bounded overlay edges, and KV bubbles gives n^2*4^(-n), hence the global logN/sqrtN lower bound. This is an elementary implicit corollary of prior ingredients; no new mechanism was verified.
findings.published_proof_caveat: KV last step appears to omit an overlay: a best-mesh energy upper bound cannot be subtracted uniformly on all competitors. A routine overlay repair is provided in REVIEW.md; this caveat does not create novelty.
findings.modern_positive_classes: The Acta2024 endpoint relation is for the enriched bulk-plus-face functional space F_T, not volume P0; Gantumur elliptic results restrict the load to L2.

novelty_residual: Explicit constants, directtailannihilation, and selectededgeCauchy bookkeeping are useful expository/reproducibility improvements. No substantive novel contribution established.
recommendation: Do not promote as a first solution or new bridge. Attribute the CDN construction and the KV bridge and theorem. Preserve the audit as reproducibility or expository work; no publication action was taken.
bounded_gaps: Final typeset CDN2012 Section 6.4 was not acquired; the public author preprint is complete.
Complete 2016 Tantardini/Veeser/Verfürth reports were not acquired; the decisive 2019/2021 primary source is fully available.
